decisions.reason: Process data archiving software is central to the firm's shift toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management, so there is no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.

This second archiving product overlaps with A and has a weak web presence, so it is the most likely candidate for consolidation, but slack from growth and hiring lets the firm carry it a while longer.
The manhole door with safety railing is a cheap extension of established hardware that serves steady municipal safety requirements, so its results likely meet aspirations.
The floating sludge extractor fits the core water-treatment machinery business, and with no sign of a shortfall there is no reason to redirect its resources.
Control technology for water engineering machinery links the firm's hardware and automation software and supports its integrated solutions strategy, so management keeps it.
Flow measurement automation software is recent, has its own page and fits the data-driven direction, so slack lets the firm carry it while its results are still uncertain.
